title: RCP Registry — Technique
description: A governed technique entry (DECISIONS #25; SR-REG-004): the semantic layer over primitives — the substitution fallback anchor (research 06) and the derived technique facet (DECISIONS #10). Fourth registry kind, same governance as the other three: append-only, kind-prefixed ontology paths (registry-governance rule 6), one file per entry, filename = id, steward-approved mints.

primitive.description: Optional association to the step primitive this gesture most directly executes; added when the primitive exists, never forced.

canonical_recipe.description: OPTIONAL link to the document that TEACHES this preparation — the answer to 'faça um roux' when the reader has never made one. CURATION, NOT ESSENCE: many roux documents may exist (a user's own, a published one, variants); the steward picks what this entry points at, and an entry without a link stays valid forever. Distinct from `teaches`, which is prose-and-URL for human reading; this is a resolvable protocol reference. Resolution follows the published order — an explicit pin outranks the consumer's own collection, which outranks this link — so a canonical link is a DEFAULT, never an override of what the reader already has.

collection.description: REQUIRED when the link crosses collections; omitted means the registry's own corpus.

version.description: Pinned revision. Unpinned links resolve to whatever the target currently is; pinned ones report drift when it moves.
